facts.fact: Wavemaker video generation typically takes two to five minutes per video, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: so most videos take two to five minutes.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's REST API rate limit is 30 requests per minute, which polling for job status consumes.
facts.quote: you waste requests against the 30-requests-per-minute limit.

facts.fact: Wavemaker webhooks are available only on the Business plan.
facts.quote: Webhooks are available on the Business plan.

facts.fact: On Wavemaker's Pro plan, the REST API can be paired with SSE progress streaming as an alternative to webhooks, while webhooks require the Business plan.
facts.quote: On Pro, you can pair the REST API with SSE progress streaming to get most of the way there

facts.fact: Adwave, according to its own page, can run a video as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks from $30 a day

facts.fact: Wavemaker signs each webhook by computing an HMAC hash of the raw request body with a shared secret and sending it in a signature header.
facts.quote: Wavemaker computes a hash of the raw request body using that secret and sends the result in a signature header.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's signature header is named X-Wavemaker-Signature.
Wavemaker treats a webhook delivery as failed and retries it if the receiving endpoint does not return a 2xx response.
facts.quote: A non-2xx response tells Wavemaker the delivery failed, which triggers a retry (more on that below).

facts.fact: Wavemaker retries failed webhook deliveries later, typically with a backoff.
facts.quote: treats the delivery as failed and retries it later, typically with a backoff.

facts.fact: Wavemaker sends a video.completed webhook event when a render finishes and a separate event when it fails.
Wavemaker video jobs are started by calling the REST API endpoint /api/v1/videos.
facts.quote: Your service calls the REST API at `/api/v1/videos` to start a render.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's video pipeline includes script, storyboard, generated visuals, voiceover, music, and an AI vision QC pass.
facts.quote: Wavemaker runs a full pipeline (script, storyboard, generated visuals, voiceover, music, and an AI vision QC pass)

facts.fact: Webhooks are included on Wavemaker's Business plan, which the page lists at $299 per month.
facts.quote: Webhooks are included on Wavemaker's Business plan ($299/mo)

facts.fact: The Business plan includes 8,000 credits a month.
facts.quote: raises you to 8,000 credits a month, up to 4K export, and 25 seats

facts.fact: The Pro plan is listed at $99 per month and includes the REST API and SSE progress streaming but not signed webhook callbacks.
facts.quote: Pro ($99/mo) gives you the REST API and SSE progress streaming

facts.fact: New users can create their first video free with 75 credits on Wavemaker.
facts.quote: create your first video free (75 credits)

facts.fact: Adwave distributes a finished video as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks starting at $30 a day, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: runs it as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks from $30 a day

facts.fact: Wavemaker webhook signatures are verified by computing an HMAC-SHA256 hash of the raw request body with the shared secret, and requests that fail the check should be rejected with a 401.
facts.quote: Compute an HMAC-SHA256 hash of the raw request body using your shared secret
